result.rationale: The diff shows `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` in both update and destroy with no nil check, then `save_host(host)` assigns `host.host = ...` and destroy calls `host.destroy` — a nonexistent id yields NoMethodError/500 instead of 404. Same for `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` if that param is missing.

judged_text: update and destroy look up the host with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and never handle a nil result, so save_host calls `host.host =` on nil and destroy calls `host.destroy` on nil. A PUT/DELETE to /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id with a stale or nonexistent id raises NoMethodError and returns a 500 instead of a 404; the same applies when params[:embeddable_host] is absent in create/update (`params[:embeddable_host][:host]` on nil → 500).
